faqs.a:
The contributions provided for in
section 86-37
shall be made notwithstanding that the minimum compensation provided by law for any
               member shall be changed. Every member shall be deemed to consent and agree to the
               deductions made as provided for herein, and payment of the member's compensation less
               such deduction for the member's contributions shall be a full and complete discharge
               and acquittal of all claims and demands whatsoever for services rendered by such member
               during the period covered by such payment, except as to benefits provided under this
               chapter.
(Code 1960, § 19-18(D); Code 1981, § 26-9)
State Law reference—
Police pensions, C.R.S. § 31-30-101 et seq.
